app.name: AccuWeather
app.short_description: AccuWeather forecasts, live, on your Wii
app.long_description:
A native Wii port of the AccuWeather Android TV app.
Live conditions come straight from the AccuWeather API over HTTPS: current conditions, the next 12 hours, a 5 day forecast and weather alerts, with the icons, fonts and colours of the Android TV app.
Press 2 (or click SEARCH) to type a city on the Wii system keyboard and jump to its forecast.
Controls D-pad left/right switch tabs D-pad up/down scroll the hourly strip A refresh B Fahrenheit / Celsius 2 search for a city + / - next / previous bundled city Wii Remote pointer click tabs, the SEARCH chip and the keyboard HOME return to the Wii Menu
Requires an internet connection (Wi-Fi settings in the Wii Menu).
